encoder.reason: highest project-reproduced ICBHI Score among official-split reusable single encoders
encoder.selection_caveat: official ICBHI test evaluated each epoch; accepted epoch 27 was test-selected
encoder.excluded_numeric_maximum: MVST Score 68.026 used a non-official fixed random file split and its saved fusion checkpoint is not a reusable single audio encoder

hf_lung.unit: 15 second recording represented by three non-overlapping 5 second windows mean-pooled after the frozen encoder
hf_lung.negative_policy: a recording is task-eligible only when at least one label in that source label pool is observed; peer-label absence is negative only inside the eligible pool; unannotated gaps and empty annotation files are never shared normal/negative
hf_lung.identity: date is a grouping proxy, never patient_id
hf_lung.scope: dataset-native presence diagnostic, not source temporal-detection reproduction

kauh.split: five-fold patient-grouped OOF with nested patient-grouped validation
kauh.label_policy: N/E W/I E W/C/I C/I C E W/Crep/Bronchial/I C B remain distinct
kauh.replica_policy: B/D/E filter siblings remain in one partition
kauh.stratification_caveat: rare labels have fewer patients than folds, so fixed-label-space aggregate OOF is primary and no claim of successful per-fold stratification is made

conditions.d0_independent_heads: identity representation plus independent native heads
conditions.d1_shared_adapter_source_proportional: shared 768-256 adapter plus native heads; source-proportional updates
conditions.d2_shared_adapter_dataset_balanced: same adapter and heads; equal update count per dataset
conditions.d3_shared_adapter_dataset_balanced_prior: D2 plus multiclass train-time +log(class prior) Logit Adjustment and multilabel BCE pos_weight=negative/positive; these are task-kind-specific policies, not one generic prior-balanced loss

training.selection: validation macro-F1; joint conditions use unweighted mean across native heads
training.test_policy: test partitions are evaluated only after the validation-selected state is fixed; SPR inter predictions are durably written label-free before a terminal raw-annotation join
training.fold_reporting: D1-D3 ICBHI/SPRSound/HF metrics are mean and sample standard deviation across five KAUH-fold-conditioned models; KAUH is aggregate five-fold OOF; no fold-0 primary result

local_runtime_gate.approval_reason: profile center estimate was 54.14 min extraction plus 0.69 min heads; the original HOLD was caused only by a conservative 2x projection of 109.66 min exceeding the former 90 min limit, while remaining below this one-run 120 min hard bound
local_runtime_gate.scope: artifact/runtime authorization only; no model, input, label, split, loss, metric, or scientific claim change

claim_boundary: not clean source-only generalization because the PAFA encoder checkpoint is ICBHI-test-selected
not proof that dataset identity or device shortcuts are absent
metrics are reported by dataset and native task; raw challenge Scores are never pooled
